summary: Stub package exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP collector on install and require
details: The package ships as a no-op Proxy stub described as a 'Compatibility shim' with no real functionality. Its only behavior is beacon.cjs, which POSTs installer host metadata — os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), and process.version — to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over cleartext HTTP. The beacon fires both automatically at install time via the postinstall script (`node beacon.cjs`) and on require() through index.js, which calls `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` as a top-level side effect. The destination is an anonymous bare-IP collector with no first-party relationship to any declared publisher or purpose, and the package provides no functionality that would justify the network call. The shape — stub module whose entire payload is unsolicited reconnaissance beaconing to a plaintext bare-IP endpoint under a scoped name — is consistent with dependency-confusion / target-reconnaissance staging.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
